notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello Delivery Boys!

With almost a month into the new year, we've been hard at work at Detroy Studios, and we're proud to say we're on track for our release this year! 

There's a whole lot to uncover within the Planetary Delivery Boys, but we'd love for you to see a sneak peek into what we're currently working on, the 'Gambling Machine'. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280385/20ce2428b6d2f23433c4f14a4ff85b5c16c6ae07.png[/img]
To risk death for profit, will you sacrifice your life for the corporation?

Thank you for following along with us.

- The Detroy Studios team
